areas.label: Oncology
areas.blurb: Targeted medicines and antibody–drug conjugates for hard-to-treat solid tumors and blood cancers.

areas.label: Immunology
areas.blurb: Precision biologics that calm overactive immune pathways in skin, gut and joint disease.

areas.label: Neuroscience
areas.blurb: New approaches to neurodegeneration, migraine and mood disorders, guided by human genetics.

areas.label: Cardiometabolic
areas.blurb: Long-acting therapies for heart failure, lipid disorders and metabolic disease.

areas.label: Rare Disease
areas.blurb: Gene and RNA medicines for small patient communities with no approved options.

news.title: Calvera presents Phase 2b data for CLV-226 in atopic dermatitis
news.summary: Investigational antibody met its primary endpoint at week 16, with skin clearance maintained through week 32.

news.title: Calvera and Northfield Genomics sign gene therapy manufacturing agreement
news.summary: Multi-year collaboration expands viral vector capacity for the rare disease pipeline.

news.title: Calvera reports second-quarter 2026 results
news.summary: Revenue grew 14% on strong demand for Dermavia and Cardelle; full-year outlook raised.

news.title: Regulators accept filing for berolumab-cvra in first-line HER-low breast cancer
news.summary: Priority review granted, with a decision expected in the second quarter of 2027.

news.title: Calvera opens new research campus in Raleigh, North Carolina
news.summary: The 400,000 square foot site will house 900 scientists and a clinical-scale manufacturing suite.

news.title: Late-breaking data for emzaratinib presented at oncology congress
news.summary: Adjuvant study shows a 41% reduction in risk of recurrence versus placebo.

news.title: Calvera reports first-quarter 2026 results
news.summary: Revenue of $4.3 billion; pipeline advanced with two Phase 3 starts.

news.title: Calvera publishes 2025 Responsibility Report
news.summary: Company reports 32% cut in operational emissions and expanded patient-access programs in 40 countries.

news.title: Calvera licenses RNA platform from Halden Bio
news.summary: Agreement adds liver-targeted delivery technology for cardiometabolic programs.

news.title: Synavo approved for early symptomatic Alzheimer's disease
news.summary: First approval for trelanemab follows positive Phase 3 results in 1,800 patients.

news.title: Calvera reports fourth-quarter and full-year 2025 results
news.summary: Full-year revenue rose 11%; dividend increased for the ninth consecutive year.

news.title: Calvera to present at healthcare investor conference
news.summary: Chief Executive Officer will outline 2026 priorities and the company's long-range plan.

news.title: Phase 3 study of corvatinib in Crohn's disease completes enrollment
news.summary: Topline results are expected in the second half of 2026.

news.title: Calvera and Merrow Health launch decentralized trial network
news.summary: Partnership brings clinical trial visits closer to patients' homes in 12 states.

news.title: Calvera reports third-quarter 2025 results
news.summary: Oncology revenue up 19%; operating margin expanded 120 basis points.

news.title: Hemavia approved for hereditary transthyretin amyloidosis
news.summary: Oral RNA medicine offers once-daily dosing for adults with polyneuropathy.

news.title: Calvera named one of the best places to work in biopharma
news.summary: Recognition highlights flexible work, mentoring and early-career scientist programs.

news.title: Lumacyte approved for HER-low metastatic breast cancer
news.summary: Antibody–drug conjugate approved after showing improved progression-free survival.

news.title: Calvera reports second-quarter 2025 results
news.summary: Revenue of $3.9 billion; full-year outlook reaffirmed.

news.title: Calvera joins global consortium on antimicrobial resistance
news.summary: Company commits funding and compound libraries to early discovery research.

news.title: Calvera begins Phase 3 program for lorvatide in obesity
news.summary: Program will enroll more than 6,000 adults across 30 countries.

news.title: Calvera reports first-quarter 2025 results
news.summary: Growth led by Dermavia, Velorix and Cardelle.

news.title: Calvera appoints new Chief Scientific Officer
news.summary: Dr. Amara Okafor joins from academic medicine to lead global research.

news.title: Calvera reports fourth-quarter and full-year 2024 results
news.summary: Full-year revenue of $15.1 billion; eight new molecular entities entered the clinic.

news.title: Glycora approved for type 2 diabetes
news.summary: Once-weekly injectable peptide improves glycemic control with weight benefits.

news.title: Calvera reports third-quarter 2024 results
news.summary: Revenue up 9%; R&D investment increased to 22% of sales.

news.title: Calvera and Lattice Fold AI collaborate on protein design
news.summary: Machine-learning partnership aims to shorten antibody discovery timelines.

news.title: Ondrelle approved for first-line metastatic lung cancer
news.summary: Approval based on overall survival benefit in the global Phase 3 trial.

news.title: Calvera completes acquisition of Brightwater Neuro
news.summary: Acquisition adds two clinical-stage neuroscience programs.

news.title: Calvera reports fourth-quarter and full-year 2023 results
news.summary: Revenue reached $13.9 billion; dividend raised 6%.

history.text: Founded in Boston by three academic researchers with one antibody program.
First medicine approved: Moravel for major depressive disorder.
Initial public offering; expansion into immunology.
Acquired a gene therapy platform; Rare Disease unit formed.
Velorix approved; oncology becomes the largest therapeutic area.
Acquired Brightwater Neuro; revenue passes $15 billion.
New Raleigh research campus opens; 16 marketed medicines.
